      A guide to the mansion

      Small returns. More light.

      1. 01

        Give a note a room.

        Paste a note and select the exact phrases you want to remember. Each phrase becomes the answer to a blank in your note.

      2. 02

        Recall before you reveal.

        Try to fill the blank in your mind. Choose how confident you feel, reveal the phrase, and honestly rate how well you remembered it.

      3. 03

        Follow the little ghosts.

        A ghost count means cards are due now. Finish a room's review queue and its window lights up. The next visit is scheduled from your rating.

      A simple practice rhythm

      Again returns in 10 minutes. Hard returns in 24 hours. Remembered moves through 1, 3, 7, 14, then 30 days. These are simple scheduling rules, not a measurement or prediction of your memory. Confidence helps you notice surprises; it doesn't change the schedule.

      Your selections create the questions. No AI model reads your notes. Data stays in this browser, so keep a backup before clearing browser storage or changing devices.
